purpose: Versioned source register for research baselines in cloth simulation, robotic garment manipulation, textile sorting and sewing. This manifest does not declare any dataset ingested or authorize redistribution. This revision adds OpenTextile-NIR, two inverse-design research comparators, a design-sorting mismatch study and a 2026 critical fabric-design review. Reported percentages/metrics are source-specific and must not be treated as universal or reproduced Luminous results.

sources.name: TexSortML

public_scope.split_protocol: garment-level stratified five-fold; all three presentation frames for a garment stay in one fold

known_limitations: 751 garments came from collection containers and were already facility-pre-sorted
one facility sample, not a random sample of all incoming waste
labels cover visual garment category and deformation, not fibre composition
small and class-imbalanced dataset
sources.intended_use: visual garment-family and presentation-state robustness only
sources.redistribution_action: verify Zenodo record license and attribution

sources.name: ClothDojo: Learned Data Generation and Benchmarking for Bimanual Garment Flattening and Folding

reported_claims.scope: bimanual garment flattening and folding across hundreds of garments
reported_claims.method: learned trajectory generation with canonical NOCS cues, then randomized appearance rendering for RGB policy training

known_limitations: preprint, not an independent Luminous replication
unseen-garment generalization remains an open challenge
simulated rollout success is not physical task success
sources.intended_use: method comparator for generated training data after independent cloth model validation
sources.redistribution_action: do not assume dataset or implementation is publicly licensed from the preprint alone

sources.name: ICRA 2024 Cloth Competition
known_limitations: in-air unfolding grasp selection only
not sewing or full production

sources.name: OpenTextile-NIR — NIR hyperspectral imaging and photography dataset
known_limitations: post-industrial sample domain; transfer to post-consumer mixed garments must be tested
pixel spectra from a specimen are correlated; never split pixels from one physical sample across train/test
verify instrument/calibration, exact class balance and file-level reuse terms

sources.redistribution_action: inspect article supplement and repository/data-package license before downloading or redistributing

sources.name: Inverse design of personalized textiles with architected curved yarns

reported_scope.validation: computational and experimental validation in three case studies

known_limitations: specific curved-yarn/additive manufacturing design family; not a universal woven/knit inverse-design baseline
reproduce the declared case studies and test generalization before comparing performance
sources.intended_use: matched inverse-design comparator for candidate generation, surrogate-driven optimization and physical validation
sources.redistribution_action: cite the paper; inspect supplement and license before reusing data or code

sources.name: Data-driven prediction and inverse design of fabric tensile properties via machine learning

method: inverse design of woven-fabric structural parameters

known_limitations: simulation-generated training data require physical transfer validation
reported scope is tensile response, not a complete fabric-property or manufacturing qualification
sources.intended_use: baseline for FEM-to-ML forward prediction and inverse structural design
sources.redistribution_action: inspect article and supplement licenses before reuse

sources.name: Design–sorting mismatch limits circularity in fast-fashion garments
known_limitations: rule-based compatibility analysis, not physical plant sorting yields
retailer product-data and selected rules define the population and metric
reported 50.3% must not be generalized to all garments or all recycling systems without reproduction
sources.intended_use: design-time sorting-compatibility rules, component visibility, blend detectability and hidden-material mismatch benchmark
sources.redistribution_action: reproduce the rule set and audit population definition; review retailer data terms

sources.name: Artificial intelligence in fabric design: a critical review of technological advancements and socio-creative implications

reported_scope.reported_material_property_prediction: some reviewed DNN studies report R2 above 0.85

known_limitations: underlying studies are heterogeneous and not a formal pooled meta-analysis
different architectures, datasets and evaluation conditions limit direct ranking
literature search closes at 2024; it is a synthesis, not a current 2026 benchmark leaderboard
sources.intended_use: broad taxonomy, human-AI design workflow, aesthetic-vs-functional metric separation and background baseline
sources.redistribution_action: cite and use the study's heterogeneity caveat; no bulk reproduction

split_policy: never split repeated spectra or frames from the same physical specimen/garment across train and held-out evaluation
hold out complete garment identities and, where available, material families and source lots
keep calibration specimens separate from scored validation specimens
keep simulator-generated observations distinct from physical observations
report source, instrument, material, garment and task strata rather than only one pooled mean
cross_dataset_rule: TexSortML visual garment-family labels are not fibre-composition labels. NIR-SORT composition observations are not garment-category labels. Fusion is permitted only with matched item identity, independent measurement provenance and explicit missing/unknown states.
claim_ceiling: This source register is a research intake manifest. It does not prove that any dataset has been downloaded, parsed, reproduced, licensed for redistribution, or evaluated by Luminous Dynamics. The companion RGBench garment asset subset is separately licensed for non-commercial research; do not treat its rights as inherited from the CC-BY-4.0 capture set.
